decision_basis: The official NHS series page resolves a discontinued four-release experimental-statistics corpus for 2008 through 2012. Source-specific acquisition and retention remain pending the maintainer's licensing decision.

releases.methodology_change: First experimental release; predicted use based on average dose and treatment length was compared with observed use where possible.
Second experimental release; unavailable comparisons retained their stated reasons.

releases.label: 2010-and-2011
releases.methodology_change: Third experimental release added a separate exploratory biologics analysis; amended on 2012-12-11 without changing figures.
Fourth and final release introduced a variation approach; corrected report and workbook versions were uploaded on 2014-02-07 after under-reporting was identified.
